Definition: apparently from a derivative of the base of G3491 (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.
BiblicalUsage: Nereus is one of the saints Paul greets by name in Rome, listed beside his sister and the rest of the household. He gets a single line, a greeting, and nothing more — a brother in the church, known to Paul and known to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a single greeting in the apostle's letter is honour enough: to be named among the saints is to be named forever.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
